svg.title: Uno R3 LDR divider and onboard status LED

g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: Uno R3 powered by USB. R2 is a GL5528-type photoresistor.

g.desc: Uno R3 powered by USB. R2 is a GL5528-type photoresistor.

g.text: The onboard L LED uses D13; no external LED is required.

g.desc: The onboard L LED uses D13; no external LED is required.

g.text: ADC uses AVCC as reference. Software thresholds: 400 (turn on), 600 (turn off).

g.desc: ADC uses AVCC as reference. Software thresholds: 400 (turn on), 600 (turn off).

g.text: The LDR response varies by part and lighting; calibrate at the installation site.

g.desc: The LDR response varies by part and lighting; calibrate at the installation site.

g.text: KiCad ERC and exact-net checks required; physical circuit is not tested.

g.desc: KiCad ERC and exact-net checks required; physical circuit is not tested.
